name: Mimic

trait.name: Elite (Modo Fatal · 5 PJs nível 14)
entries: Versão nivelada para cima: PV ×1,6, CA +2, ataques, salvaguardas e CDs +3, dados de dano ×1,5 e +3 de dano fixo. ND efetivo +3.

trait.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
entries: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8} (with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} if the target is {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the mimic), reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Piercing damage—or 19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) Piercing damage if the target is {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the mimic—plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Acid damage.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The mimic shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true blob form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

fluffEntries: Mimic: stat block oficial XMM (5.5e), elevado ao ND 5 para o modo fatal.
